We specialize in

Fumigation that reaches every hiding place

Some infestations can't be solved with spot treatments. Tent fumigation treats the entire structure at once — every beam, wall void and piece of furniture inside the seal.

Drywood Termites

Drywood colonies live deep inside the wood of your home — in the attic, walls and furniture. Whole-structure fumigation eliminates the entire colony, everywhere at once.

Ask about termites →

Powder Post Beetles

These beetles bore into hardwoods, beams and flooring, quietly weakening them for years. Fumigation stops them inside the wood where surface sprays can't reach.

Ask about beetles →

Bed Bugs

Bed bugs hide in seams, joints and cracks throughout a structure. A full fumigation treats the whole space at one time — no corner left untreated.

Ask about bed bugs →

Homes, Businesses & Structures

Single-family homes, apartment buildings, commercial properties and other structures — if it can be sealed, we can fumigate it and protect your investment.

A word from our owner

We know what your home means to you

We know how important your home is to you — and how stressful it can be when an infestation is discovered. Whether you're dealing with drywood termites, beetles, bed bugs, or you're not quite sure yet, we're here to lend a hand.

With 20 years of experience protecting homes through state-regulated fumigation practices, we use the latest and most effective methods to carry out the fumigation process safely on your home, business or other structure. Our goal is always the same: to protect your most valuable investment.

How it works

The fumigation process, step by step

We walk you through every step before we begin, so there are no surprises on the day.

1

Inspect & quote

We inspect and measure the structure, confirm the pest, and give you a clear price.

2

Prepare

We guide you through preparing the home — bagging food and medicine, and arranging a short stay away.

3

Tent & fumigate

The structure is sealed under tarps and fumigated, reaching pests in every corner of the wood and walls.

4

Aerate & return

We ventilate and clear the structure, then confirm when it's safe for you to move back in.
